codes.evidence_quote: The gypsy has not been and never will be a creator, but only an interpreter and perpetuator.
codes.target: Gypsies in relation to flamenco creation and transmission
codes.rationale: The passage frames a whole identity group through its supposed cultural role, denying authorship while assigning interpretive and perpetuating functions.

codes.evidence_quote: The only thing he has done -- and it is not a small thing -- has been to perpetuate in Andalucía some musical styles that would have been lost
codes.target: Flamenco/cante flamenco as preserved through Andalusian transmission
codes.rationale: The passage grounds flamenco value in continuity and survival of older musical styles through preservation over time.

possible_but_not_emitted.reason: The passage draws boundaries around authorship, but it does not clearly define proper flamenco by excluding impure or fake forms.

derived_analysis.target: Gypsy claims to flamenco creation and Andalusian sources of flamenco

codes.evidence_quote: the flamenco guitar never had a more illustrious master than Ramón the Madrileñian
codes.rationale: The passage canonizes Montoya through superlative hierarchy and master status.

codes.evidence_quote: How great is the loss which flamenco art has suffered by his death!
codes.target: Ramón Montoya's contribution to flamenco art
codes.rationale: The passage explicitly evaluates Montoya's artistic importance and the magnitude of his loss.

codes.evidence_quote: he realized that his art did not receive the merit it deserved. He suffered very much when they did not understand his playing.
codes.target: audiences' failure to appreciate Montoya's guitar art
codes.rationale: The passage uses critique to distinguish proper appreciation of Montoya's artistry from listeners who fail to understand its merit.

possible_but_not_emitted.reason: Montoya is said to have given lessons, but the visible passage does not make pedagogical authority the main discourse function.

derived_analysis.target: Ramón Montoya as canonical flamenco guitarist

codes.evidence_quote: The many cantes that are closely related to or derived from the verdiales present a confusing picture to the casual aficionado or the guitarist who is not familiar with the melody of each.
codes.target: learners' access to fandangos de Málaga classification and performance knowledge
codes.rationale: The article explicitly mediates technical knowledge for aficionados and guitarists who may lack familiarity with the forms.

codes.evidence_quote: Most of these cantes differ from each other only in their melodic lines and perhaps do not deserve classification as distinct cantes
codes.rationale: The passage exercises classificatory critical authority by judging whether closely related cantes merit distinct status.

possible_but_not_emitted.reason: The article discusses origins and evolution, but mostly as technical history rather than using roots or continuity to authorize present flamenco value.
Technical terms and performance treatment are present, but the excerpt does not clearly apply an aesthetic quality criterion.

derived_analysis.target: fandangos de Málaga and related cantes

annotation_notes: Article is truncated; annotations rely only on the visible technical/classificatory excerpt.

codes.evidence_quote: The dignity and wisdom of the quiet one, Santiago, and the elegance and good quality of public relations of Antonio, are an institution between Sevilla and Huelva.
codes.rationale: The passage explicitly praises the performers' qualities and social-artistic standing.

codes.evidence_quote: Their style, evident in their records, is a mixture of sweetness, balance of voices, delicacy and strength when it is needed
codes.rationale: The passage defines their musical value through named aesthetic criteria such as sweetness, balance, delicacy, and strength.

codes.evidence_quote: They know how to say the sevillana in a manner matched by few others.
codes.rationale: The passage creates a comparative hierarchy by placing their sevillanas interpretation above most others.

codes.evidence_quote: A two week workshop for beginning and intermediate-advanced dancers. Each day, the workshop will feature a morning technique class and an afternoon repertory class for each level.
codes.rationale: The passage frames flamenco learning through a structured workshop with levels, technique classes, repertory classes, and institutional access.

codes.evidence_quote: Mr. Morca's credentials are known to most of Jaleo's readers: He has worked with many of the top Spanish dance companies... and is widely acclaimed as a teacher.
codes.rationale: The passage legitimates the workshop through Morca's recognized credentials and teaching authority.

possible_but_not_emitted.reason: The juerga with participation by all suggests participatory setting, but appears as a workshop activity rather than an evaluative contrast with spectatorship.
References to top companies and acclaim support teaching authority, but do not independently construct a flamenco canon or ranking.

derived_analysis.target: Morca Flamenco Workshop and Mr. Morca
